displayName: ExportMate backend: file storage refused or failing

documentation.content: Requests to the backend's bucket gs://${BUCKET} were refused (permission) or failed on Google's side. A refused write means files never land: check the service account's role on the bucket. GetBucketMetadata refusals are left out: the client asks for them, the object-only role refuses, and reads still work.

conditions.displayName: Refused or failed object requests in 5 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="storage.googleapis.com/api/request_count" AND resource.type="gcs_bucket" AND resource.label.bucket_name="${BUCKET}" AND metric.label.method!="GetBucketMetadata" AND metric.label.response_code=one_of("PERMISSION_DENIED","UNAUTHENTICATED","INTERNAL","UNAVAILABLE","DEADLINE_EXCEEDED")
